description:
A Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the eventbus execution in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-09-22 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution using a crafted serialized Java object.


This vulnerability was patched on 22 September 2026, and no customer action is needed.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Chill Image Photo Gallery Final Tiles Grid final-tiles-grid-gallery-lite allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects Image Photo Gallery Final Tiles Grid: from n/a through 3.6.18.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ricardo Martins PagBank / PagSeguro Connect pagbank-connect allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects PagBank / PagSeguro Connect: from n/a through 5.1.9.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in David Lingren Media LIbrary Assistant media-library-assistant allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Media LIbrary Assistant: from n/a through 3.43.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozy Vision Technologies Pvt. Ltd. SMS Alert Order Notifications sms-alert allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects SMS Alert Order Notifications: from n/a through 4.0.3.
Authentication Bypass by Spoofing vulnerability in TMS Amelia ameliabooking allows Identity Spoofing.This issue affects Amelia: from n/a through 2.4.14.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in wp.insider Simple Membership simple-membership allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Simple Membership: from n/a through 4.8.9.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Socio WP Telegram Widget and Join Link wptelegram-widget allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects WP Telegram Widget and Join Link: from n/a through 2.2.16.
Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Webdeclic WPMasterToolKit wpmastertoolkit allows Code Injection.This issue affects WPMasterToolKit: from n/a through 2.26.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PI Web Solution Product Enquiry for WooCommerce enquiry-quotation-for-woocommerce allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Product Enquiry for WooCommerce: from n/a through 2.2.34.64.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in fifu.app Featured Image from URL featured-image-from-url allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Featured Image from URL: from n/a through 6.1.8.
Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Tobias WebinarIgnition webinar-ignition allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects WebinarIgnition: from n/a through 4.28.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeisle MPG multiple-pages-generator-by-porthas allows Stored XSS.This issue affects MPG: from n/a through 4.2.6.

A flaw has been found in Free5GC 4.3.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the component SMF. This manipulation causes resource consumption. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

An attacker might be able to forge its own source IP, smuggle DNS records or bypass EDNS options filtering via a specially crafted DNS query when EDNS Client Subnet is enabled between DNSdist and its backend.

A vulnerability was detected in Free5GC 4.3.0. This affects the function handleAssociationSetupRequest of the file internal/pfcp/association.go of the component SMF. The manipulation results in authentication bypass by spoofing. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The patch is identified as aab44f6f90f89d8b60c34ee5d1e8af887fd5ddab. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.
Denial of service via oversized DoH query

An attacker can trigger a large memory use by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is retrieving the response from its backend. Instead of releasing the memory corresponding to the cancelled stream right away, DNSdist was mistakenly keeping it around until the end of the QUIC connection.

When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist does not replace existing X-Forwarded-For headers but merely append a new header to the query, the first header was used by DNSdist instead of the last one, making it possible for a client to spoof its own IP address.

When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the proxy protocol being enabled between DNSdist and one of its backends, an outgoing TCP connection could be wrongly reused for a query received over the same incoming DNS over HTTPS connection but with a different X-Forwarded-For header, causing the backend to consider the query as coming from the same remote client than the first query received on the outgoing connection.
An attacker can cause a denial of service by sending crafted HTTP queries to the internal webserver. The webserver is not enabled by default and is protected by an ACL.

An attacker allowed to send AXFR or IXFR queries can cause an outgoing TCP connection to the backend to be stuck, causing a denial of service to other clients trying to reuse the same outgoing connection.

Setting an empty API key was not properly disabling access to the internal HTTP API, despite being documented as such. This allowed an attacker whose IP address was allowed by the webserver ACL to bypass the authentication and get read-only access to the API.

When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse proxy by sending DNS over HTTPS GET queries with a body. DNSdist should either refuse the query or ignore the HTTP body, but instead was processing the content of the HTTP body rather than the query present in the HTTP path.
Rejected reason: Not a separate vulnerability: dependency update. See GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2.
